quote:
You spend years building walls to keep out the storm. 
You forget that walls also block the warm morning light. 
Some ghosts live rent-free inside your quietest evening thoughts. 
You hold the heavy key to your own locked cage. 
Let the cold wind finally sweep through empty, hollow rooms. 
True freedom begins the moment you stop defending your scars.
